readme.summary: IoCs for Warden Stealer Analysis and more technical information at: <https://www.gendigital.com/blog/insights/research/warden-stealer-rust-infostealer-analysis. The extras/ folder contains an [example of Warden Stealer's dynamic configuration](extras/wardenstealerconfiguration.bin). Samples (SHA-256) 1050 samples. Full list in [samples.sha256](samples.sha256). Note: [samples.sha256](samples.sha256), [samples.sha1](samples.sha1) and [samples.md5](samples.md5) contain hashes of both Warden Loader and Warden Stealer samples (the lists do not differentiate between the two components).
